phase: US financial V5 — private PostgreSQL TEST customer credits and payments

invariants.book: Immutable ERP4 baseline/policy/promotion; ordered events and one derived cursor/hash. SQL independently reconstructs every event, exact posting and receipt; no second writable current ledger.
invariants.money: Canonical minor-unit decimal strings, SQL NUMERIC and TypeScript BigInt. Cumulative proportional allocation with half-up rounding, including final cents; received/credited/outstanding remain distinct. Historical taxed lines require adjustment plans even if this slice tax rounds to zero.
invariants.authority: Living versioned PostgreSQL TEST grant, current workspace/configuration/policy under locks; trusted callback before/after RPC and local async validation; captures before await; final revocation wins. TEST live audit actor clock <= PG clock_timestamp+30 seconds; historical read/retry actor allowed. This is not a tax/accounting-date rule or a D1/Auth/Stripe distributed transaction.
invariants.fiscal: Exact proof in immutable DB-owner-provisioned private TEST plan tied to org/invoice/key; service_role cannot self-provision. adjustment_pending is a plan, not an observed provider reversal. No provider call.
invariants.commit: Prefix canonical SHA and exact revision CAS; event+receipt+cursor atomic with deferred completeness. Exact old retry returns before CAS; legacy/promotion keys reserved. Invalid direct partial insert rolls back.
invariants.capability: Settlement excludes ERP commands; foundation append stays PF010. Foundation read/promotion/receipt reject after tail exists rather than return frozen current data. Promotion and first append require two transactions.
invariants.security: RLS and PUBLIC/anon/authenticated revoke; new functions SECURITY INVOKER/search_path empty. service_role is trusted and can read private tables/helpers; no claim of isolating financial data from it. Grants/plans DB-owner-only; no new bypass GUC or definer.
invariants.maintenance: Previous foundation global TRUNCATE restriction remains, including shared CH/nonpromoted tables; requires operational review before hosted adoption.

adapter.transport: Synthetic RPC responses; actual financial runtime transitions; not hosted SQL

postgres.execution: Real local PostgreSQL WASM, 26 prior migrations plus settlement migration, actual ERP4 tax TEST invoice issuance and promotion then append
